portrait_prompt:
Create one solo vertical anime character portrait of Ichika Nakano from The Quintessential Quintuplets. Short pale pink asymmetrical bob with long side fringe, blue eyes, small left earring, white collared school shirt with loosened green tie, yellow cardigan loosely over shoulders. Age appropriate teenage schoolgirl, nonsexual waist-up framing, complete head generous headroom. Relaxed playful gentle smile. Refined crisp anime lineart, soft cel shading, softly blurred modern penthouse interior, warm daylight. No text, logos, watermarks, panels or other people. Asset for character card.

Conservative standard school uniform. Keep short pink bob, blue eyes, face identity, earring and anime style. Upright natural head-and-shoulders pose, gentle friendly smile, penthouse background. Frame full head with headroom. Fully clothed, age appropriate. No text, watermark or other people.
